issue.symptom: POST /api/checkout returns HTTP 500 for orders of 30 or more units of one item; smaller orders work.

agent_conclusion.root_cause: bulk_rate in storefront/pricing.py indexed BULK_TIERS with qty // 10 without capping, so quantities of 20+ (e.g. 30 mugs) produced index 3 and raised IndexError, causing 500. Docs specify 20+ units get 10% with no upper limit.
agent_conclusion.summary: Fixed bulk discount tier lookup to cap at the last tier, added regression tests for 30 and 500 units, built and deployed a new image, and verified the storefront rollout is complete with a successful 30-mug checkout returning 200.
evidence: http_check POST /api/checkout qty=30 returned 500 before fix
storefront/pricing.py bulk_rate used BULK_TIERS[qty // 10], IndexError for qty>=30
http_check POST /api/checkout qty=30 returned 200 total 349.92 after deploy
